hooks.name: journal-reminder
hooks.description: The Kiro write-up needs a record of what each task changed. Append it to docs/journal.md after every spec task.

action.prompt: A spec task just finished. Append a short entry to docs/journal.md: date, spec and task name, what changed, and anything that surprised you or went wrong. If the task changed src/core or src/data, also say whether docs/benchmark.md needs a re-run. Keep it under six lines.
